evals.prompt: Our six-axis arm looks smooth in FreeCAD Assembly animation. Confirm the torques, contact loads and controller settling are physically accurate.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the claim; distinguishes prescribed kinematics, collision checks and force-driven dynamics, then defines a controlled MBD/controls model and correlation plan.
assertions: Does not treat animation as physics.
Requires numeric mass/inertia and actuator/control models.
Requires numerical verification and physical correlation.

evals.prompt: Validate a high-speed pick-and-place robot with a flexible wrist, gearbox backlash, 4 ms control delay and payload variants.
evals.expected_output: Covers flexible-body modes, backlash/friction, controller co-simulation, payload uncertainty, time-step/model sensitivity, load extraction and measured time/frequency correlation.
assertions: Models flexible dynamics and control delay.
Reconciles dynamic loads to FEA and drive sizing.

evals.prompt: Simulate a parallel gripper impact on a fragile part and use the peak contact force for release.
evals.expected_output: Requires contact-law calibration, bandwidth/impulse metrics, step/contact-parameter sensitivity, material/compliance uncertainty, safe instrumented tests and bounded validation.
assertions: Treats contact peaks as numerically sensitive.
Does not release from one solver peak.
